text: Seok-woo, a cynical workaholic and divorced father, takes his young daughter Su-an on the express train from Seoul to see her mother in Busan. Just before departure a scraped-up woman slips aboard, and soon [the dead are surging through the carriages|threat|the dead that rise], with every bite [turning another passenger|rules|it passes to others]. Alongside a blue-collar worker and [his pregnant wife|who_suffers|expectant parents], a high school baseball team and a ruthless executive, father and daughter fight carriage by carriage, while frightened survivors [bar the doors against their own|wrong|abandonment and rejection].
